Sentiment and regulatory risks: data-center diesel legal pushback, e-bike cease-and-desist actions, Bezos share sales, or any AI capex disappointment could hurt sentiment.
Data limitations: AWS segment revenue and margin, formal guidance, and insider-transaction data are unavailable, and the news sample is only 20 of 172 eligible records.
